cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.

mechanism: A uses its old inspector trainee confidence lesson to turn an unsupported landing into a formal approval request whose signature itself supposedly supplies support.
confusable: Not generic confidence coaching: assurance is literally proposed as a structural material and then certification becomes load-bearing.
comparison: Future-weather seal versus professional certainty converted into structure.
seedUse: D148 invisible landing/museum/twenty/certification; S05 trained steadiness.
